output.reason: Both proposals relied only on the one-line note [ev-e4380102a652]. The linked PR fills in the details. It says installing a provider package that references a DeploymentRuntimeConfig was "currently broken on main", shown with a dev build tagged v1.21.0-rc.0.163 [ev-2955a2390de6]. The provider revision went unhealthy because applying the Deployment failed with duplicate volumeMount paths "/tls/client" and "/tls/server" that "must be unique" [ev-a95dca88b623]. The fix is a DeepCopy of the runtime config's Deployment template spec in internal/controller/pkg/runtime/runtime_defaults.go [ev-c8ee24a21df6]. That is enough to write the assertion: subject = the provider Deployment built from a DeploymentRuntimeConfig; change = bug fix; applicability = provider packages that reference a DeploymentRuntimeConfig; consequence = none for operators, since the PR describes a regression on unreleased main that this release fixes.
